_comment: The C³ Arcade reads this at runtime (tools/arcade/index.html) and the Break Room's rail chip counts it for its 'N GAMES' label (assets/cinema.js, the `marquee` field in data/tools.json). ADDING A GAME IS THIS FILE AND data/tools.json — nothing else. No code change, no fingerprint run, no build step. Every game needs a row HERE (so the arcade lists it) and a row in data/tools.json with the same `slug` (so #/tool/<slug> opens it, the phone list finds it by search and the C³ menu lists it); the arcade never links to a game's real URL, only to `#/tool/<slug>`, because reps must never see a repository hostname — see claude/v15-framed-data-and-hidden-repos.md.

_schema.slug: REQUIRED. The tool slug. Must match a `slug` in data/tools.json exactly — that row is what the launch link (#/tool/<slug>) resolves against, and a game whose slug is not in tools.json is listed with its launch disabled and a plain note saying so.
_schema.title: REQUIRED. The name on the cabinet, as the game itself spells it. The arcade prints THIS, never the tool's label, so a game whose page carries no <title> (After Hours does not) still reads correctly.
_schema.blurb: REQUIRED. One line — what the game is, in the room's voice. Printed under the title.
_schema.url: The game's real address. RECORDED, NOT RENDERED: the arcade never prints it and never links to it. data/tools.json is what the viewer actually loads; this is here so the manifest is a complete record of the cabinet and so a mismatch between the two files is visible in a diff.
_schema.art: OPTIONAL. { file, alt } — `file` is a filename inside arcade/art/, exactly the way printouts/manifest.json names a filename inside printouts/. Same-origin and drawn here, never hotlinked to another host. OMIT IT and the arcade composes a tile from `tint` and the title's initials instead, which is what makes 'one row and nothing else' true for the next game Jeff adds. `alt` is normally "" — the tile is decoration beside a heading that already names the game, so alt text would be a duplicate announcement.
_schema.tint: OPTIONAL. A hex from theme.css §02 that keys the generated tile (and the card's hairline when art is present). Defaults to --brass #c8973f. Use a token value, never a new colour.
